scope: Parent static review of frozen native-HAR working-owner v1 production/control flow and filesystem/retention helpers. Not actual API/native qualification. Source inventory covers 14 candidate changes plus five direct references, not a full transitive build.

findings.problem: Synchronous CDP Detach precedes HAR owner/deadline barrier and can prevent Teardown reaching cancellation/explicit incomplete ownership.
findings.required_regression: Block exact detach; teardown deadline returns an error, retains lease/admission, and retires only after actual detach and runtime-worker join.

findings.problem: startFinish/startRuntimeJoin recover defer recognizes only non-nil panic. Goexit may close completion channels with nil error although finalization/join never completed, permitting false-success teardown or cleanup. startClose Goexit may strand closeDone.
findings.required_regression: Exercise Goexit in each entered callback; explicit incomplete ownership, no premature raw deletion/release, and unretired owner cannot return success.

findings.problem: Retirement renames a joined generation to a .retired- random tombstone, but cleanup planning skips every non-generation name. Interrupted proven-joined retirement is not resumable despite preserved manifest.
findings.required_regression: Resume recognized original-generation-bound joined tombstone after interrupted rename; preserve unknown/unjoined/replaced identities.

findings.problem: Completed retention scan under the new shared namespace has unbounded entry/error accumulation and its supplied deadline bounds acquisition only. Large preexisting directories can monopolize all publishers.
findings.required_regression: Bound scanning, cancellation and error retention with explicit failure; do not report successful silent truncation.

owner_self_review_finding: Working prune SizeBytes remains zero instead of bounded actual child sizes. Preserve exact accounting in fix.
qualifications: Private descriptor locks and conservative unknown/unjoined preservation are appropriate
No-replace publication avoids exposing a partial final artifact
Crash/process death, arbitrary hostile ancestor replacement, five-platform ACL/native packaging and complete BE-3 delivery remain open
Working byte admission is a point-in-time check, not proof of aggregate active-writer/RSS enforcement
